name: select_servo_speed
summary: Select the slowest Servo speed that fits an explicit trajectory-duration budget.

generality.rationale: Uses only a generic joint target, live joint state, and Servo's task-independent trajectory model.
assumptions: The blocking world wait must complete within a known experiment/RPC budget.
limitations: World-clock duration does not predict wall time when the simulator runs slower than real time.
Does not command motion, verify arrival, check collision, or establish task effect.
tested_tasks: robotwin/press-stapler-aloha-agilex (harness_v2_iter_005 exposed world-time versus wall-time distinction)

level.rationale: One state read plus deterministic evaluation and selection across bounded Servo trajectory candidates.

composition.strategy: Evaluate Servo's trajectory generator at allowed speed fractions and select the slowest candidate within the duration budget.

provenance.failure_gap: Qwen chose speedFraction=0.2; the first blocking Servo exceeded its wait budget, stopped halfway, and verify_joint_arrival correctly rejected the partial motion.
evidence: approach Servo failed after about 61.8 wall seconds
measured joints remained far from the approach target and native_success=false
